🕯️ Sigrun Eiriksdottir is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
What Sigrun kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
"Sigrun's gone." Meera looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Sigrun." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.

📖 The Codex turns a page: Sigrun Eiriksdottir, 85 days. The mantle passes to Henry Zhang.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Henry Zhang, 36 — an emergency dispatcher. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
The village's quarrel was with Sigrun — and Sigrun is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
You knew Sigrun — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting her, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Meera, Grace speak for Henry — "Sigrun trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Henry before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
